api_attempts.failure_reason: The execution sandbox could not establish an HTTPS connection to api.openalex.org. Direct Node fetch and Node fetch with HTTPS_PROXY=http://127.0.0.1:7897 both returned TypeError: fetch failed. curl via that proxy returned curl (35) schannel AcquireCredentialsHandle failed: SEC_E_NO_CREDENTIALS. The available web reader could retrieve only the base endpoint and rejected parameterized OpenAlex API URLs as unsafe, so it cannot substitute for the reproducible query script.
